name: Eightfold AI
tagline: Talent intelligence platform for AI-driven hiring and workforce planning.
description: Eightfold AI runs a Talent Intelligence Platform that uses deep learning to match candidates and employees to roles based on skills and potential rather than keywords. Built on a dataset of over a billion career profiles, it powers talent acquisition, internal mobility, and workforce planning, with agentic features like an AI Interviewer and an AI-native applicant tracking system.
insight: Founded by ex-Google/Facebook engineers Ashutosh Garg and Varun Kacholia; reached a $2.1B valuation in a 2021 SoftBank-led $220M Series E.
edge: Models skills and adjacencies across 1B+ career profiles, surfacing non-obvious internal and external candidates that keyword-based ATS filters miss.

references.title: AI startup Eightfold valued at $2.1B in SoftBank-led $220M funding
